rows.label: qst200204_msg0007
rows.name:
But I heard you two were
best friends[ML:Dash ]?

rows.label: qst200204_msg0008
rows.name:
I don't know who told you that,
but she was never my friend.

rows.label: qst200204_msg0009
rows.name:
If you're not customers, leave[ML:Dash ]
You're getting in the way of my work.

rows.label: qst200204_msg0010
rows.name:
Why are you so reluctant
to talk about her?

rows.label: qst200204_msg0011
rows.name:
Because I don't want to talk
about a traitor like her!

rows.label: qst200204_msg0012
rows.name:
She was Bahn's favorite, a great
dancer, and everyone fawned over her[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst200204_msg0013
rows.name:
Then she betrayed me and disappeared!
She's no best friend. She's no friend
at all!

rows.label: qst200204_msg0014
rows.name:
This won't be straightforward.
What should we do?

rows.label: qst200204_msg0016
rows.name: Leave it to me! I'll persuade her!!
